status: Wicked source-assisted indirect experiment, not automatic ARC offload

admission.records: 1..65536 sorted 16-byte records; one group; no change to CPU sort or tie order
admission.objects: compact sidecar written by existing object producer in this frame; bounds/generation checked for every referenced record
admission.state: identical mesh, effective uint8 LOD and stencil across packet; opaque object color alpha=1, alphaRef>=1, fadeDistance=FLT_MAX, finite positive radius; finite half-distance
admission.mesh: valid index buffer, 1..64 subsets, no requested mesh shader/tessellation/custom shader/wireframe
admission.fallback: original CPU packing if admission fails or versioned frame slot is busy

metadata_consumers.mesh: CPU mesh/index/material/PSO setup; record word 0, checked across packet
metadata_consumers.lod: CPU GetLODSubsetRange; record override or compact producer sidecar
metadata_consumers.stencil: CPU material/object stencil combination; compact producer sidecar
metadata_consumers.alpha: CPU PSO choice; object force-alpha is proven false by admission, material alpha-test selection unchanged
metadata_consumers.offset: GPU StartInstanceLocation; zero for the supported single group, CPU push byte offset remains zero
metadata_consumers.first_end: diagnostic only; packet is one group from 0 to N
metadata_consumers.aabb: not supported; forward-light merging passes remain CPU

versions.retirement: native graphics queue fence after all frame command lists and cross-queue waits, value=frame+1
versions.reuse: consumer fence completion must cover owner frame before any CPU overwrite or allocator reset; unfinished slot falls back, no CPU wait
versions.queue_order: early current-instance upload and compute append to same graphics queue as subsequent indirect draws; existing later instance upload skipped

measurement.performance_readback: timestamps only; no metadata, packed output or draw arguments returned
measurement.diagnostic: deferred exact output/metadata/argument checks after consumer fence; actual indirect commands still render
measurement.full_gpu_envelope: timestamps before early upload and after all frame queues complete; includes queue idle time, not GPU active-work sum
measurement.cpu: full Present-call cadence with producer, preflight, upload, command recording, original remaining work and diagnostics
